# Sentinel · RBMC station monitor

A fork of [Sentinel](https://github.com/territorial-dev/sentinel) that watches the real-time GNSS stations of IBGE's RBMC through the RBMC-IP NTRIP caster, one test per station, with the stations on a map at the top of the public status page.

- **What it adds and how it works:** [docs/fork/RBMC.md](../docs/fork/RBMC.md)
- **Sentinel itself:** [README](../README.md) and the [guides](../docs/guide/)
- **Updating Sentinel:** run the *Sync upstream* workflow; see [Updating from upstream](../docs/fork/RBMC.md#updating-from-upstream)

Image: `paschendale/sentinel-rbmc`.
